title: Howling at the Rose Window
description: A black dog stands in the rain on wet cobblestones, head raised in a howl toward a massive, glowing circular rose window filled with intricate floral patterns in deep red and pale green. A crowd of white line-drawn figures holding umbrellas and lanterns surrounds the scene under a dark, stormy sky.
prompt: A black silhouette dog howling upwards on rainy cobblestone street at night, large ornate circular rose window glowing with intricate floral and vine patterns in deep burgundy and sage green dominating the stormy sky, crowd of people rendered as white line art holding umbrellas and lanterns, reflections in puddles, dramatic gothic atmosphere, high contrast, moody lighting
